record.question: WIDAL test detects:
record.explanation: Answer B: O and H agglutinins. Widal agglutination measures antibodies against Salmonella Typhi O and H antigens. A positive result has limited diagnostic accuracy and needs context; the item asks only what the test detects. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/journals/weekly-epidemiological-record/wer101-32/; https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/370492/WHO-V-B-03.07-eng.pdf?sequence=1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
